title: Apple close versus moving average
intent: Show where Apple's daily closing price is above or below its twenty-day moving average while preserving exact interpolated crossings.

ai.create: Create a Close-versus-twenty-day-average difference chart directly from AAPL rows. Keep the rolling reducer visible; Plot may use differenceY, while TanStack must interpolate every crossing and pass typed positive and negative lobes to areaY.
ai.maintain: Change the selected date window or rolling period without losing exact crossing boundaries, semantic colors, the original Date and Close fields, inferred extents, or cast-free channels.
